availability_policy: usable one calendar day after the historical Z.1 release date
forecasting_variable: annual log book-leverage growth computed between the current quarter and four quarters earlier inside the same historical Z.1 release
point_in_time_note: Every observation and its four-quarter comparison value are read from the same original Federal Reserve Z.1 release page; later revisions are not used. All source HTML is frozen locally with SHA-256.
purpose: first-release broker-dealer leverage data only; no strategy performance
